summary: Keep deferred checkpoint storage coherent under memory and disk pressure
details: Checkpoint publication and active transfers retain their pages until completion; supersession alone no longer discards an older branch's unwritten pages.
Persistence queues are bounded by allocated bytes, shared pages are deduplicated, and transient failures retry missing copies.

Sustained memory pressure can retire cold checkpoints before reclaiming their last copy. Shutdown drains writes within its budget and removes incomplete entries; restart validates recovered payload availability.
